abstract: We prove the entropy-degree theorem for continuous maps from a closed orientable non-collapsed $RCD(K,N)$ space $X$ to a closed negatively curved locally symmetric $N$-manifold $Y$, with $N \geq 3$. In the equality case, under a fundamental group index condition, we show the space is isometric to a smooth locally symmetric Riemannian manifold, and the map is homotopic to a Riemannian covering.
hook: A map from an RCD space to a locally symmetric manifold obeys an entropy-degree bound, with rigid equality.
summary: The paper proves an entropy-degree inequality for continuous maps from closed orientable non-collapsed RCD(K,N) spaces to closed negatively curved locally symmetric manifolds of dimension at least 3. In the equality case, with a condition on fundamental group index, the space is a smooth locally symmetric manifold and the map is homotopic to a covering. It is a pure mathematics result with narrow assumptions.
title: Entropy-degree rigidity for non-collapsed $RCD$ spaces
